messages:
Maya: Heads-up on the compact metrics row UI. Two issues: legend text wraps into two lines when the left nav is collapsed, and very tall spikes in the mini-sparkline are visually clipped so the preview looks flat. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.example/ux/compact-row-clip.png

Derek: Clipping is misleading. Could the preview autoscale per-row so spikes show up?

Lena: Per-row autoscale helps visibility but breaks eyeballing relative magnitude across rows. Alternative: keep global scale and add a discrete spike indicator when the true max is off-screen, with a hover to show peak value/time.

Sam (Design): I prefer the spike indicator approach. For the legend wrap, option A: single-line truncation + ellipsis with tooltip. Option B: collapse unit label into an icon. A is faster.

Theo (Eng): (A) is trivial with CSS text-overflow; (B) needs interactive affordances and keyboard targets. We can ship A first and iterate.

Maya: Make sure the tooltip is keyboard and screen-reader accessible (not just a title attr). Sam, can you draft the copy?

Sam (Design): Tooltip draft: "Series: request latency — peak 2.4s at 14:12 UTC — unit: p95 (ms)". For the ellipsis state, SR text: full series name + "press Enter for details".

Derek: Spike popup content suggestion: two lines: "Peak: 2.4s (200% of median)" and "Time: 14:12 UTC". Keyboard: focus + Enter opens it.

Maya: A11y nit: marker must meet 3:1 contrast and be reachable without reordering tab stops.

Theo (Eng): Implementation notes: SVG overlay for sparkline and a thin <line> element for marker. Use aria-labelledby for the popup. Performance fine for ~50 rows; we'll batch DOM updates.

ui-bot: Note: added design checklist to PR #4227 — https://git.redwood/PR/4227

Sam (Design): Decision: ship legend truncation (A) + accessible tooltip, add spike indicator + popup, delay per-row autoscale to v2. I'll write the a11y spec and copy.

Maya: Action items: Sam — a11y spec & copy; Theo — prototype branch; Derek — popup content for PR; Lena — small-screen mock validation. Target: prototype by Friday EOD.

Theo (Eng): Starting spike now, will share demo link here.

Maya: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
